race.title: OPC Home Guard Remembrance Handicap Chase
race.verdict: SEA WARRIOR surpassed his hurdling form at first time of asking over fences when a ready winner here 2 weeks ago and his follow-up claims appear to be bright. Ahanaglogh was on the up from his low base when last seen and is a threat on reappearance, along with Koenigsstern . SEA WARRIOR (IRE) AHANAGLOGH (IRE) KOENIGSSTERN (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Sea Warrior (5/2), Mutley Crew (10/3), Ahanaglogh (7/2), Koenigsstern (5/1), Sanitiser (6/1), Constantinian (16/1), Glancing Back (25/1)
